question: In chapter 1100, Kuma and Saturn talked about the Warlord that Ace defeated. What kind of guy was he?
answer: This is him. His name is Hanafuda. He has a hobby of collecting Zoan-type Devil Fruits, especially Ancient ones, and it is said that he may have been plotting something, but now we won't know. His height is 514 cm and his epithet is "King of Lizards".
name: Goshun
